premise: Acorn wishes to fly like Butterfly; she climbs onto Mushroom's cap, flaps her little arms and wishes hard — then a breeze makes Mushroom sneeze, ACHOO, Acorn tumbles off into the grass, and she's sure she flew. Butterfly agrees.
inspiration: Icarus and every folk tale of wanting to fly, turned: a gentle tumble, a sneeze for wings, and a friend who says yes.
lesson: Trying is its own kind of flying.

en-US.title: Acorn Wants to Fly
en-US.text: [softly] {butterfly:enter} Butterfly was flitting over the meadow, and little {acorn:enter} Acorn watched her. {acorn:face sad} [sighs] I wish I could fly, she said. {butterfly:go to meadow} Butterfly fluttered down into the grass. Then climb up high and try! she said, and {butterfly:live hold} folded her wings to watch. Up popped {mushroom:enter} Mushroom. [excited] Climb on me! {acorn:go on mushroom} Up scrambled Acorn, onto the red cap. {acorn:face happy} {acorn:wobble x2} She flapped her little arms. Flap, flap, flap! Nothing. {acorn:live hold} So she closed her eyes tight and wished. [whispers] Please… just one little flight… {canvas:wind 0.6 8s} Just then, a breeze tickled Mushroom. {mushroom:live} Ah… ah… {sfx:achoo} ACHOO! {acorn:go to meadow right} {acorn:spin} Off the cap flew Acorn — up, round and round, and down into the soft grass. {sfx:plop} Plop! {acorn:live resume} She opened her eyes. [gasps] I FLEW! {mushroom:face surprised} Well, said Mushroom, sort of. {butterfly:live resume} Butterfly opened her wings and fluttered them. [happily] You flew, she said. Beautifully. {acorn:face happy} {acorn:hop x3} Again! cried Acorn. And Mushroom promised to save her another sneeze.

es-ES.title: Bellota quiere volar
es-ES.text: [softly] {butterfly:enter} Mariposa revoloteaba sobre el prado, y la pequeña {acorn:enter} Bellota la miraba. {acorn:face sad} [sighs] Ojalá yo pudiera volar, dijo. {butterfly:go to meadow} Mariposa bajó a la hierba. ¡Pues sube bien alto y prueba! le dijo, y {butterfly:live hold} plegó las alas para mirar. Asomó {mushroom:enter} Seta. [excited] ¡Súbete a mí! {acorn:go on mushroom} Bellota trepó hasta el sombrero rojo. {acorn:face happy} {acorn:wobble x2} Agitó sus bracitos. ¡Flap, flap, flap! Nada. {acorn:live hold} Así que cerró los ojos muy fuerte y pidió un deseo. [whispers] Por favor… un vuelito nada más… {canvas:wind 0.6 8s} Justo entonces, una brisa le hizo cosquillas a Seta. {mushroom:live} Aaa… aaa… {sfx:achoo} ¡ACHÍS! {acorn:go to meadow right} {acorn:spin} Bellota salió volando del sombrero: arriba, vueltas y más vueltas, y abajo, a la hierba blandita. {sfx:plop} ¡Plof! {acorn:live resume} Abrió los ojos. [gasps] ¡HE VOLADO! {mushroom:face surprised} Bueno, dijo Seta, más o menos. {butterfly:live resume} Mariposa abrió las alas y las agitó. [happily] Has volado, dijo. Y muy bien. {acorn:face happy} {acorn:hop x3} ¡Otra vez! gritó Bellota. Y Seta le prometió guardarle otro estornudo.

achoo.prompt: a tiny, cute comic sneeze, achoo, with a soft puff of air after it, playful

plop.prompt: a tiny acorn landing softly in thick grass, a light comic plop, playful
